title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: adaptivesort
text:
adaptive sort
adaptive sort
(definition)
Definition:
A
sorting algorithm
that can take advantage of existing order in the input, reducing its requirements for computational resources as a function of the disorder in the input.
See also
adaptive heap sort
.
Note:
